recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. The rest of the FHIR-26938 note and existing search example already convey the approved GET/POST search audit pattern; adding a new example now would go beyond the final resolution, but leaving the invalid element path would mislead implementers.
issue_request: FHIR-26938 was a Published/Persuasive Security WG clarification for R5 asking the AuditEvent page to explain how a FHIR search, especially a POST search, should be recorded. The accepted resolution added a Recording Search Events note saying the search request belongs in AuditEvent.entity.query as the whole HTTP request encoded as base64Binary, with the harmonized search parameter string optionally recorded as descriptive text.
initial_application: Commit 9284053de1b13444a6cb249d31fcd6e0838e3e7c added the Recording Search Events note to source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml. The note remained in active AuditEvent source, but it carried forward a typo from the resolution that named AuditEvent.entry.description, which is not an AuditEvent element.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinition source defines AuditEvent.entity.description and AuditEvent.entity.query, the existing search example uses description and query under entity, and the AuditEvent search parameter bundle indexes AuditEvent.entity.description. The cited Zulip thread supports capturing the full HTTP request in entity.query without sanitization while allowing a usable description of what was processed; Confluence minutes confirm the Security WG block vote approved FHIR-26938 as Persuasive.
reconciliation: Changed only the broken path in source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml from AuditEvent.entry.description to AuditEvent.entity.description, aligning the narrative with the active resource definition and existing example.
source_changes: source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml: changed the Recording Search Events note's optional harmonized search string location from AuditEvent.entry.description to AuditEvent.entity.description.
